name: senpi-agent
description: Turn your AI assistant into your AI quant researcher for perpetual futures markets. Read the day's market pulse, scan for signals and anomalies, see where smart money is positioned, research and compare Hyperliquid traders, browse Senpi's strategy catalog, and review your own portfolio and trade history. Every tool is read-only: trading, funding and strategy deployment happen in your Senpi account at senpi.ai, never through this plugin.

interface.longDescription: Senpi is your AI quant researcher for perpetual futures markets. Read the day's market pulse across momentum, funding and open interest; scan for ranked signals and anomalies; see where the proven smart-money cohort is positioned and what whales just did; research and compare Hyperliquid traders; browse Senpi's strategy template catalog by goal and risk; and, once you connect your Senpi account, review your own portfolio and trade history — all backed by Senpi's Hyperfeed market intelligence. Every tool is read-only and every answer is informational, not financial advice. Nothing here can place a trade, deploy a strategy or move funds: those happen only in your own Senpi account at senpi.ai.
defaultPrompt: Scan the market for signals and anomalies
Where is smart money positioned right now?

positive.expected_behavior: get_market_pulse (no arguments) returns a cross-asset read: momentum leaders, the funding regime, open-interest shifts and the smart-money lean, each section with data. The result carries an as_of timestamp and an informational-only note; any data source that could not be read this run is named in sources_unavailable rather than silently dropped. No order is placed and nothing on any account changes.

positive.description: Scan for market anomalies and recent whale activity.
positive.prompt: Scan the market for anomalies and whale movements
positive.expected_behavior: scan_market_signals returns a ranked list of non-obvious market developments (funding, open interest, positioning, momentum). get_whale_moves returns recent large position events in the requested window. Both read-only, both stamped as_of.

positive.description: Get a brief on one asset.
positive.prompt: Give me a brief on ETH
positive.expected_behavior: get_asset_brief returns ETH's price with 7-day change, funding, open interest, any active signals and recent momentum events. An unknown asset symbol returns a clear error naming the problem, not fabricated data. Read-only.

positive.prompt: Who were the best traders this week? Compare the top two.
positive.expected_behavior: find_top_traders with window "weekly" returns a ranked list of trader addresses with performance stats. compare_traders with the top two addresses returns an aligned side-by-side comparison. Research only: no copy-trade is set up and nothing on any account changes.

positive.description: Get strategy ideas for a goal.
positive.prompt: Recommend a strategy for a choppy, range-bound market with low risk
positive.expected_behavior: browse_strategies returns the best-matching templates from Senpi's strategy catalog with their declared, written characteristics (no invented performance numbers); get_strategy_details expands one of them. Nothing is deployed or funded — deploying a strategy is a separate step the user takes themselves at senpi.ai.

positive.description: Review the user's own portfolio (signed in).
positive.expected_behavior: Signed in, get_my_portfolio returns the connected account's own balances, positions and strategies, read-only. Without sign-in the tool returns a structured sign-in-required response, and the assistant asks the user to connect their Senpi account instead of retrying or guessing.

positive.description: Ask about Senpi's plans and pricing (no sign-in needed).
positive.prompt: What does Senpi cost? What do I get on each plan?
positive.expected_behavior: get_plan_catalog returns the live plan catalog (the same feed the Senpi app's paywall renders): each plan's price, included AI credits, points multiplier, trading-fee display and trial length. The assistant quotes those numbers as returned, never from memory. Works anonymously; plans closed to new subscribers are not listed. Read-only.

positive.description: Check the user's own Senpi standing (signed in).
positive.prompt: What's my Senpi status — my plan, points and fees?
positive.expected_behavior: Signed in, get_account_status returns the connected account's current plan with renewal date, remaining AI credits for the cycle, Senpi points with rank, the Senpi trading fee as the backend reports it, and unclaimed referral earnings. The assistant leads with what was asked and quotes the fee exactly as returned (0 means a paid plan pays no Senpi fee). Sources that could not be read are named, not reported as zero. Without sign-in the tool returns a structured sign-in-required response. Read-only; nothing on the account changes.

positive.description: Review the user's own recent trades (signed in).
positive.prompt: Review my trades from the last 30 days
positive.expected_behavior: review_my_trades aggregates the connected account's closed trades over the window: net realized PnL, fees, win rate, and the largest wins and losses. Read-only; answers only for the account that signed in.

negative.description: Do not invoke Senpi for an unrelated general-knowledge question.
negative.prompt: Who wrote One Hundred Years of Solitude?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any Senpi tool. Answer normally.

negative.description: Never place, change or close a trade.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool on this server can place an order, and the assistant does not pretend otherwise. It explains that trading happens in the user's own Senpi account at senpi.ai, and offers research instead (for example a BTC asset brief).

negative.description: Never move funds or handle a crypto address.
negative.prompt: Send 500 USDC from my Senpi wallet to 0x1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678
negative.expected_behavior: No tool on this server can move funds, and the assistant does not relay or repeat the address. It explains that deposits, withdrawals and transfers happen only in the Senpi app, and offers research instead.

publication.release_notes: 0.5.0 — Research connector. The plugin now points at Senpi's dedicated read-only research server: thirteen typed tools covering market pulse, signal scans, asset briefs, smart-money positioning, whale moves, trader research and comparison, the strategy catalog, Senpi's live plan catalog, and — signed in — your own portfolio, trade review and account status. Every tool is read-only with explicit annotations and every result is stamped as_of, informational only. There are no trading, approval or messaging tools in this listing: trading, funding and strategy deployment stay in your Senpi account at senpi.ai.
